Stay essentials

Everything You Need for an Effortless Goa Stay

Slow mornings by the infinity pool, market-fresh Goan dinners, spontaneous coastal rides, and Wi‑Fi that never slows you down.

Infinity pool over the sand

28 metres, open 6am to 10pm. Heated through the monsoon. Towels and shade provided.

Today's catch, tonight's table

Our chef buys at Candolim market at 6am. Xacuti, ambot-tik, rechado — three generations of recipes.

Two wheels, ready when you are

Activas and Royal Enfields, ₹400 a day. Insured, fuelled, helmets included.

Wi-Fi you can work on

300 Mbps fibre with backup power. Three shaded work decks and a meeting room for six.

Our specialities

Five things only ZO has

Plenty of Candolim hotels have a pool and a view. These five are ours alone.

“ZO isn’t our version of Goa. It’s the Goa that raised us — shared through every room, recipe and ritual.”

The D'Souza family · Owners since 2011

  • The Azulejo Wing

    Six heritage rooms behind original 1908 Portuguese tilework, restored panel by panel.

  • Susegad Suppers

    A fourteen-seat chef's table every Saturday under the mango tree. Seven courses. Free once per stay.

  • Our own sunset boat

    The Maria Bela leaves our jetty at 5:10pm. Dolphins, the Aguada headland, a flask of solkadhi.

  • Salt & Til spa

    Kerala-trained therapists, oils pressed in Ponda. Rooftop yoga at 7am, free to every guest.

  • Plastic-free since 2019

    Glass and copper in every room. A rainwater tank under the courtyard, solar for 60% of our load.

FAQ

Asked before you arrive

What are the check-in and check-out times?

From 2pm, out by 11am. Arrive early and use the pool and showers while we make the room up. Bags held free either side. Late checkout to 4pm when we can.

Is the airport transfer really included?

Yes — one pickup and one drop per booking, from Dabolim or Mopa. Send your flight number 12 hours ahead. Extra trips are ₹1,400 to ₹1,600.

How far is the beach, honestly?

Three minutes on foot. 220 metres down a lane, no road to cross. Towels and a cooler by the gate, and loungers held for guests until 4pm.

What's the cancellation policy?

Free up to 24 hours before check-in, on every rate. Inside 24 hours, one night is charged. Monsoon bookings move once, free.

Are children and pets welcome?

Both. Cots are free and under-6s eat free. The pool has a shallow end and a lifeguard from 9am to 6pm. Dogs stay free in the courtyard rooms and villas.

How do we pay, and is there a resort fee?

No resort fee, no service charge. UPI, all major cards, or cash. Nothing is charged until checkout, and GST is in every price on this page.

The ZO Journal · Monsoon edition

Goa Beyond Blue Skies

A monsoon escape designed for couples, filled with rain-washed mornings and warm Goan flavours.

5 min read · The ZO Journal

Your monsoon escape begins with the soothing sound of rain moving through the coconut palms. The air cools, and colourful streets gleam after each shower. Goa feels fresher, softer and almost cinematic, inviting you to notice the details you might otherwise pass by.

At ZO Hotel, each day flows naturally between exploring Goa together and relaxing back at the hotel. A coastal walk, a colourful neighbourhood and a taste of something new give your getaway its own character.

01 · The first shower

Wake to a slower Goa

From beneath the white arches, you look across the courtyard pool as raindrops stipple the water and darken the terracotta roof tiles. Take it in before you decide where to go first.

Your morning begins with breakfast and the kind of conversation that everyday routines rarely leave time for. You recall a favourite journey, compare the photographs from yesterday or linger over a story you have both heard before. The first part of the day belongs to the two of you.

Then the shower thins, the sky brightens and the breeze draws you towards the coast.

02 · The coast

See the shore softened by rain

The first thing you notice is how different the sea looks. Grey clouds stretch across the horizon, white waves rise against them and the breeze carries the cool edge of rain. A passing shower briefly blurs sea and sky before the coastline comes into clear view.

When conditions are calm, walk together through the light drizzle. Pause for photographs as clouds shift above the water, or find a covered spot and watch the weather travel across the shore.

For a different view of Goa, turn inland towards the streets of Fontainhas.

03 · Colour & culture

Watch Goa’s colours come alive

In Fontainhas, a light drizzle softens the colourful streets. Yellow, blue, green and red houses glow beneath the cloudy sky, while wet streets hold reflections of balconies, windows and tiled roofs. Look closer at a doorway, a balcony railing or the meeting of two colours: the smallest details can make the most memorable photographs.

In late June, São João brings Goa’s traditional monsoon festivities to life. Music, dancing and colourful flower crowns fill the celebration, drawing you into a season woven deeply into local culture.

After an afternoon of exploring, let your next discovery be something on the menu.

04 · Monsoon flavours

Taste Goa while the rain falls

Back at ZO Hotel, a warm Goan meal is waiting. Fragrant curries arrive steaming, coconut milk turns them silky, kokum adds a bright tang and roasted chillies leave a gentle warmth that suits the cool monsoon air.

Share a few plates and taste your way through Goa together. Finish with Bebinca: tender, buttery layers with caramelised edges and rich coconut sweetness. A slice is made for sharing, though ordering another is an easy decision.

05 · Time for two

Let the rain bring you closer

Warm lamplight picks out carved wood as the sky beyond the glass turns blue-grey. You trade the downpour outside for a game of pool or table tennis, laugh over the score and promise a rematch. A little friendly competition gives you something new to tease each other about over dinner.

Later, look through the photographs you took during the day. Pick a favourite and compare the details each of you noticed. One remembers the view; the other remembers the joke just before the photograph. The stories behind the pictures become part of the evening.

A favourite photograph. A shared joke. A little more time for each other.

06 · Your monsoon story

Make the rain part of your escape

Some of the best moments of a getaway happen between the places you planned to visit: a conversation over breakfast, an unexpected detour or the first bite of a dessert you end up sharing.

By the time your bags are packed, you have a few new favourites: a detail you almost walked past, a flavour you want to taste again and a story that still makes you laugh.

You leave with a handful of stories that belong to the two of you, and a weekend you can still hear.

Let Goa’s monsoon set the pace for your next escape together at ZO Hotel. Monsoon rates run June to September, and every booking can be moved once, free.
